a.covariance: unbiased empirical covariance of 128 exactly isotropic cue rows
a.formula: C_t=0.8^(2t) I_4; PR=4 at every finite t

b.shading: deterministic initial-perturbation envelope, not an uncertainty interval

c.target: w^T A^4 E(z), so native residual is exactly w^T b_arm

d.limitation: only symbol counts are matched in this analytic example; no universal periodicity effect
d.risk: population sum-squared optimal linear error; independent mean-zero cue covariance I_2 and terminal noise sigma^2 I_2

analytic_controls.scope: constructed analytic controls, not trained-model observations

pilot_audit.overlap: categorical models and arms exactly equal; continuous arm differences below display resolution
pilot_audit.uncertainty: none displayed; no independent-training uncertainty estimated

probe_scale_artifact.feature_standardization: training mean and population standard deviation; floor f=1e-8
probe_scale_artifact.formula: r=a/max(a,f); MSE=(alpha/(r^2+alpha))^2 for population-variance-one train and test designs
probe_scale_artifact.scope: noiseless constructed scalar encoding; not a re-reduction of trained pilot probes
probe_scale_artifact.seed: deterministic cues; seed 0 only for unused label-permutation control

scientific_scope: Analytic identifiability examples and a failed-competence seed-0 pilot audit; no harmful-collapse, cross-modal, causal-memory or Floquet finding.
